'''Labor Valley''' was a sector on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Corellia/Legends|Corellia]] that was home to dozens of interconnected industrial factories that produced everything from raw [[Durasteel/Legends|durasteel]] to [[Hyperdrive/Legends|hyperdrives]] to [[Thermal detonator/Legends|thermal detonators]]. This was one of the reasons why [[Corellian/Legends|Corellian]]-manufactured high-tech goods such as [[Starship/Legends|starship]] and parts were considered amongst the best in the [[Galaxy/Legends|galaxy]]. In this area, millions of middle-class Corellians found their livelihoods by working in Labor Valley.<ref name="TORC">{{TORcite|type=codex|Labor Valley}}</ref> Most of the factories were build around [[3840 BBY]], though the industrialization of the area began much earlier than that.

All this changed during the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire's]] [[Battle of Corellia|invasion]] of Corellia in the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] that devastated the region. This saw both [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic]] and [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] forces battling for control over the key factories while destroying those that they were unable to hold for themselves. As a result, vital plants were left in ruins and massive fires raged out of control at a major fuel refinery. These events turned an industrial paradise into an apocalyptic inferno where Corellian citizens had no choice but to look in horror as they witnessed everything they had built being methodically destroyed.<ref name="TORC" />
